# P3 deploy-box runbook — env prefixes and systemd units

The P3 restructure renamed workspaces, env prefixes and systemd units. The repo half is
committed; **the boxes are not**. Until these steps run, a redeploy brings apps up with no env
block — every `PREFIX__` lookup misses — and the renamed units do not exist.

Applies to the VPS (rutba.pk) and the LAN box (`rutba-nvr@192.168.0.46`). The LAN box keeps its
master env **off-git**, so it must be edited in place; nothing in this repo will update it.

> Do the env half and the unit half in the **same window**. An app whose unit was renamed but
> whose env was not will start and then fail every authenticated request.

## 1. Env prefixes — 23 changed

`OLD__VAR` becomes `NEW__VAR`; the part after `__` is untouched. Applied longest-prefix-first so
`RUTBA_WEB__` cannot chew `RUTBA_WEB_USER__`.

| App | Old prefix | New prefix |
|---|---|---|
| orders | `RUTBA_ORDER_MANAGEMENT__` | `ORDERS__` |
| manufacturing | `RUTBA_MANUFACTURING__` | `MANUFACTURING__` |
| marketplace | `RUTBA_MARKETPLACE__` | `MARKETPLACE__` |
| control | `RUTBA_INVENTORY__` | `CONTROL__` |
| campaigns | `RUTBA_CAMPAIGNS__` | `CAMPAIGNS__` |
| portal | `RUTBA_WEB_USER__` | `PORTAL__` |
| accounts | `RUTBA_ACCOUNTS__` | `ACCOUNTS__` |
| helpdesk | `RUTBA_HELPDESK__` | `HELPDESK__` |
| payroll | `RUTBA_PAYROLL__` | `PAYROLL__` |
| social | `RUTBA_SOCIAL__` | `SOCIAL__` |
| rider | `RUTBA_RIDER__` | `RIDER__` |
| console | `RUTBA_ADMIN__` | `CONSOLE__` |
| core | `RUTBA_CORE__` | `CORE__` |
| seed | `RUTBA_SEED__` | `SEED__` |
| mail | `RUTBA_MAIL__` | `MAIL__` |
| storefront | `RUTBA_WEB__` | `STOREFRONT__` |
| stock | `POS_STOCK__` | `STOCK__` |
| crm | `RUTBA_CRM__` | `CRM__` |
| cms | `RUTBA_CMS__` | `CMS__` |
| ess | `RUTBA_ESS__` | `ESS__` |
| pos | `POS_SALE__` | `POS__` |
| auth | `POS_AUTH__` | `AUTH__` |
| hr | `RUTBA_HR__` | `HR__` |

```bash
cp .env.production .env.production.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)   # this edits in place
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_ORDER_MANAGEMENT__/ORDERS__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_MANUFACTURING__/MANUFACTURING__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_MARKETPLACE__/MARKETPLACE__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_INVENTORY__/CONTROL__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_CAMPAIGNS__/CAMPAIGNS__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_WEB_USER__/PORTAL__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_ACCOUNTS__/ACCOUNTS__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_HELPDESK__/HELPDESK__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_PAYROLL__/PAYROLL__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_SOCIAL__/SOCIAL__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_RIDER__/RIDER__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_ADMIN__/CONSOLE__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_CORE__/CORE__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_SEED__/SEED__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_MAIL__/MAIL__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_WEB__/STOREFRONT__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^POS_STOCK__/STOCK__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_CRM__/CRM__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_CMS__/CMS__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_ESS__/ESS__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^POS_SALE__/POS__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^POS_AUTH__/AUTH__/' .env.production
sed -i 's/^RUTBA_HR__/HR__/' .env.production
```

Verify — must print nothing:

```bash
grep -oE '^(RUTBA_ORDER_MANAGEMENT|RUTBA_MANUFACTURING|RUTBA_MARKETPLACE|RUTBA_INVENTORY|RUTBA_CAMPAIGNS|RUTBA_WEB_USER|RUTBA_ACCOUNTS|RUTBA_HELPDESK|RUTBA_PAYROLL|RUTBA_SOCIAL|RUTBA_RIDER|RUTBA_ADMIN|RUTBA_CORE|RUTBA_SEED|RUTBA_MAIL|RUTBA_WEB|POS_STOCK|RUTBA_CRM|RUTBA_CMS|RUTBA_ESS|POS_SALE|POS_AUTH|RUTBA_HR)__' .env.production
```

## 2. systemd units — 9 renamed

Stop and disable the old unit **before** enabling the new one, or both bind the same port and
the second fails to start.

| App | Old unit | New unit | Port |
|---|---|---|---|
| strapi | `rutba_pos_strapi` | `rutba_strapi` | 4010 |
| storefront | `rutba_web` | `rutba_storefront` | 4000 |
| stock | `rutba_pos_stock` | `rutba_stock` | 4001 |
| pos | `rutba_pos_sale` | `rutba_pos` | 4002 |
| auth | `rutba_pos_auth` | `rutba_auth` | 4003 |
| portal | `rutba_web_user` | `rutba_portal` | 4004 |
| orders | `rutba_order_management` | `rutba_orders` | 4013 |
| control | `rutba_inventory` | `rutba_control` | 4017 |
| console | `rutba_admin` | `rutba_console` | 4022 |

```bash
sudo systemctl disable --now rutba_pos_strapi
sudo systemctl disable --now rutba_web
sudo systemctl disable --now rutba_pos_stock
sudo systemctl disable --now rutba_pos_sale
sudo systemctl disable --now rutba_pos_auth
sudo systemctl disable --now rutba_web_user
sudo systemctl disable --now rutba_order_management
sudo systemctl disable --now rutba_inventory
sudo systemctl disable --now rutba_admin
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now rutba_strapi
sudo systemctl enable --now rutba_storefront
sudo systemctl enable --now rutba_stock
sudo systemctl enable --now rutba_pos
sudo systemctl enable --now rutba_auth
sudo systemctl enable --now rutba_portal
sudo systemctl enable --now rutba_orders
sudo systemctl enable --now rutba_control
sudo systemctl enable --now rutba_console
```

## 3. Verify

```bash
systemctl list-units "rutba_*" --no-pager        # all NEW names, all active
curl -sf localhost:4020/api/health || echo FAIL  # core answers
```

An app that starts but 500s on every authenticated route almost always means its env block did
not resolve — check that its `PREFIX__PORT` uses the new prefix.
